description: This PHP trait provides common exception handling methods for API endpoints, such as generating specific exception instances and validation helpers for entity existence and parameter validation.

methods.name: getBadRequestException
methods.description: Returns a BadRequestException instance with a specified message.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Returns a NotImplementedException instance with a specified message.

methods.name: getRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Returns a RecordNotFoundException instance with a specified message.

methods.name: getForbiddenException
methods.description: Returns a ForbiddenException instance with a specified message.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfNotExist
methods.description: Throws a RecordNotFoundException if the given entity is null or not an instance of the specified class.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfEmptyIds
methods.description: Throws a RecordNotFoundException if the provided array of entity IDs is empty.

methods.name: getInvalidParamException
methods.description: Returns an InvalidParamException with details about invalid parameters.
